rules: Evaluation unit: one 'before' photo (non-packaged) or 'front' photo (packaged).
Ground truth per photo: every ASA24 line linked to that photo, with its FNDDS code and grams eaten.
A dish is the set of ASA24 lines sharing a FoodNum in one photo (a sandwich, a recipe); food identification is scored per dish.

Category for codes outside FNDDS 2017-2018: 8-digit ASA24 variants take the category of the nearest FNDDS code by prefix; SR Legacy recipe ingredients get no WWEIA category or FNDDS subgroup, only their SR Legacy food group.
ASA24 lines without a photo (NAlist) are kept in unlinked.parquet and excluded from photo scores.
ASA24 records what was eaten; a 'before' photo shows what was served. Leftovers in the 'after' photo explain part of any overestimate.
Split: participants hashed into dev (about 10%) and test; prompts are tuned on dev only.
